name: platform-foundation
description: 基盤 (platform): 共有カーネル (Result/時刻)、設定読込、JSON ファイル保存、12 ソースの取得 adapter (git/praeforma/praeforma-acceptance/anatomia/anatomia-cli/repo-artifacts/voluptas/elegantia/concordia/concordia-reviews/revisor/actio) と Anatomia / Revisor CLI の execFile 実行 (引数配列・env 調整・タイムアウト)、HTTP/HTML 配信面 (ルータ・API・画面・スプリント表示・エクスポート)、Web 公開入口 (Host/Origin・Cloudflare Access 検証・閲覧専用レベル)、定期更新 (1 プロジェクトずつ直列)、composition root。業務判断は持たない。
cardTemplate: Summarise the "platform-foundation" domain: shared kernel, config, JSON file storage, the twelve source adapters (including Actio sprints, Pf acceptance, Cc domain-review posts and the Anatomia / Revisor CLIs run through execFile with an argument array), HTTP+HTML delivery surface with the sprint views and exports, the public entrance (Host/Origin, Cloudflare Access verification, read-only viewer level), the serial periodic scheduler and the composition root. No business decisions live here.
